goals.0: Overflow buf[20] (read by scanf %24s) to overwrite val with 0xdeadbeef and get a shell.
goals.1: narnia1 executes the contents of the EGG environment variable — shellcode placed there runs with narnia2's privileges.
goals.2: Overflow the 128-byte argv buffer in narnia2 (strcpy) and redirect execution into shellcode to read narnia3's password.
goals.3: Use narnia3's unbounded strcpy to overwrite the output-file variable so the program itself copies narnia4's password file into a file you can read.
goals.4: Overflow narnia4's stack buffer and redirect execution into shellcode to read narnia5's password.
goals.5: Exploit narnia5's format-string bug to defeat its stack check and read narnia6's password.
goals.6: Abuse the paired strcpy buffers in narnia6 (terminator trick) to hijack the called pointer and read narnia7's password.
goals.7: Use narnia7's snprintf format-string bug (%n) to rewrite a function pointer to the built-in password-printing helper.
goals.8: Overflow narnia8's small buffer into its return-address variable and jump to environment shellcode to read narnia9's password.
goals.9: Final account: logging in as narnia9 shows the CONGRATULATIONS completion file — game complete.
